newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Endemol takes stake in German TV producer.
newsitem.headline: Endemol takes stake in German TV producer.

text.p: Dutch television production company Endemol Entertainment NV said on Tuesday it had taken a 49 percent stake in German television production firm GAT Film & TV Produktion.
Endemol said it had an option to expand its stake to 85 percent in the future.
GAT has 40 employees on the payroll and also employs some 30 freelance staff.
It posted a turnover of 30 million German marks in 1996. its customers include German TV channels ARD, ZDF, Sat 1 and PRO 7.
